$note: Build sheet for EmailFlare API (0xdps/emailflare, MIT), built from trunk commit cf31f33 of 2026-11-01. Upstream's own template (/deploy/emailflare, 'Cloudflare Email', 0xlabs-space) runs ghcr.io/0xdps/emailflare:latest = v2.0.2 of 2026-06-29, the pre-split layout; upstream never published the emailflare-api image its README names (only -staging builds, last s0.0.5 of 2026-08-13). So we build Dockerfile.email-api ourselves (.github/workflows/build.yml). Scope: the API product only, no Inbox, no Cloudflare Worker deploys. Policy gate: REVIEW (outbound mail). Mitigation: mail only ever leaves through the Cloudflare Email Sending API with the deployer's own token; there is no SMTP path in the code. Without CF credentials only test keys work, which store mail in the in-app Test Mailbox. One container: Caddy on $PORT serves the UI and proxies /api, /v1, /health to Node on 3001; embedded mesahub-server (SQLite) on 3002 keeps data in /data. upsert.py strips every $note key and mints fresh UUIDs.
name: EmailFlare API

deploy.$note: Image CMD /app/start-email-api.sh is kept (no start command). Upstream railway.json uses /health + ON_FAILURE.

volumeMounts.$note: mesahub DATA_PATH defaults to /data in the start script.

PORT.$note: Caddy binds :$PORT on all interfaces (Go listener is dual-stack). Pinned so the domain target port matches.
PORT.description: Port Caddy serves the dashboard and API on.

NODE_ENV.$note: Dockerfile does not set it; compose does. production makes SESSION_SECRET mandatory and the session cookie Secure (Railway edge is https).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Password for the admin dashboard. Copy it from this variable to log in.

MESAHUB_URL.description: Embedded SQLite database stored on the /data volume.

CF_API_TOKEN.$note: Optional so a fresh deploy boots and works with test keys before the deployer touches Cloudflare. env.ts defaults it to empty.
CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with Account > Email Sending (Edit) and Zone > Email Routing (Edit). Needed for live sends and domain setup. Guide: https://emailflare.dev/cloudflare-token

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Needed for live sends.
